description: Watching for Wind: An Effort to Get the Upper Hand on Wildfire is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by San Diego Gas & Electric; U.S. Forest Service (USFS); University of California at Los Angeles. After Santa Ana winds contributed to devastating wildfires in 2007, San Diego Gas & Electric worked with partners to monitor threats posed by the wind. Coverage: the United States (2015). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
